title: 第一章 寒巷残骨孤影求生第二章 寂骨吞灵凡躯铸根
content_zh:
隆冬腊月，北风卷着碎雪，像无数把冰冷的小刀，切割着青元国黑石镇的每一寸土地。
这座坐落于沧澜域边缘的小镇，是这片低等凡俗世界里再普通不过的一隅。天地间灵气稀薄到近乎虚无，既无飞天遁地的仙人，也无呼风唤雨的神魔，世人穷尽一生，也逃不开生老病死的轮回，百年寿元，弹指即逝。在这里，强者的定义从来不是参悟大道、执掌法则，仅仅是身强体健，能在乱世寒冬里挣得一口吃食，护住自身性命。
镇子最西侧，是一片连绵的低矮棚户区，房屋皆是黄泥混合着碎茅草堆砌而成，墙体斑驳开裂，不少地方能看到内里裸露的枯枝。寒风穿过墙缝，发出呜呜的呼啸，如同深夜里孤魂的低泣。整条街巷坑洼不平，路面结着厚厚的冰碴，混杂着冻硬的污泥与腐烂的菜叶，踩上去咯吱作响，稍不留意便会滑倒在地。
街巷深处，一间摇摇欲坠的茅草屋，便是烬孤宸栖身之所。
屋子不足两丈见方，四面漏风，屋顶的茅草早已朽烂，细密的雪沫顺着缝隙飘落，在冰冷的泥地上积起薄薄一层。屋内没有桌椅，没有床榻，唯有一块被磨得光滑的青石板，横置在墙角，算是少年唯一能够休憩的地方。空气里弥漫着浓重的寒气，夹杂着淡淡的霉味与尘土气息，冷得人血液都仿佛快要凝固。
烬孤宸盘膝坐在青石板上。
他身上套着一件破烂不堪的粗布麻衣，布料早已失去原本的颜色，多处撕裂，棉絮外露，根本抵挡不住刺骨的寒风。身形单薄得令人心惊，脖颈纤细，肩头瘦削，隔着破旧的衣衫，能清晰看到皮下凸起的骨节，显然常年食不果腹，饱受饥寒折磨。
少年约莫十五六岁年纪，面容算不上俊美，却生得极为清冽。肤色是长久不见暖阳的苍白色，下颌线条紧绷，唇瓣毫无血色，紧紧抿成一条冷硬的直线。最引人注目的是他的双眼，那是一双漆黑深邃的眸子，不像同龄少年那般藏着懵懂、希冀或是怨怼，反倒如一汪万年寒潭，沉寂、淡漠，看不到半分情绪起伏，仿佛世间万物，都入不了他的眼底。
长长的睫毛垂落，遮挡住眸底深处那一点无人察觉的锋芒。他脊背挺得笔直，哪怕身处这般破败苦寒之地，哪怕浑身伤痕累累，身姿也不曾有半分佝偻，如同风雪之中独存的孤松，纵使根基浅薄，也不肯向命运低头。
一阵剧烈的咳嗽突然从他胸腔里传出，沉闷而压抑。
身子微微一颤，烬孤宸抬手捂住胸口，指节因为用力而泛白。丝丝缕缕的腥甜顺着喉咙涌上，他偏过头，一口暗红的血丝落在脚边的泥地上，在惨白的雪沫映衬下，显得格外刺目。
胸口三根断裂的肋骨还在隐隐作痛，每一次呼吸，都牵扯着受损的经脉，带来一阵阵钻心的疼。右腿更是不敢轻易挪动，昨日被粗壮的木棍狠狠踢中，骨头虽未彻底折断，却也肿起老高，皮肉青紫一片，此刻僵硬麻木，稍一用力便剧痛难忍。
记忆如同冰冷的流水，缓缓在脑海中铺开。
昨日午后，天阴沉沉的，风雪比今日还要猛烈几分。他饿了整整两天，腹中空空如也，五脏六腑都像是搅在了一起，饥饿感啃噬着他的意志。为了活下去，他硬撑着虚弱的身子，去到镇子中心的街巷，想碰碰运气，看看能不能捡拾一些旁人丢弃的残羹冷炙。
黑石镇以东，是镇上富户聚居的区域，青砖黛瓦，高墙大院，与西侧棚户区宛若两个天地。当地大户林家的管家带着几名护院出行，随行的仆从不慎掉落了半块粗粮饼。那饼质地粗糙，掺着大量麦麸，在富贵人家眼中不值一提，可对于饿到极致的烬孤宸而言，却是足以救命的食物。
他当时没有多想，只是本能地弯腰去捡。
可这一幕，落在高高在上的护院眼中，便成了不知天高地厚的偷窃。
“哪里来的野小子，敢捡林府的东西？”
粗哑的呵斥声响起，几名身材壮硕的护院立刻围了上来。这些人常年干粗活，体魄强健，平日里在镇上作威作福，欺凌弱小早已是常态。不等烬孤宸辩解，拳脚便如雨点一般落了下来。
他自幼孤苦，无父无母，五岁那年双亲接连离世，偌大的世间，再无半个亲人。这些年靠着乞讨、捡拾杂物苟活，从未学过什么防身的本事，身形又瘦弱，面对几名壮汉的殴打，根本没有半点反抗之力。

拳头砸在胸口，木棍踢在腿上，冰冷的谩骂夹杂着戏谑的笑声，在街巷里回荡。他们下手极重，全然不顾他的死活，仿佛殴打这样一个无依无靠的孤童，只是一件打发无聊的乐事。最后，领头的护院一脚将他踹翻在结冰的路面上，冷笑着啐了一口，带着众人扬长而去。
半块粗粮饼被踩得稀烂，混入泥水之中，彻底无法入口。
而他，则躺在冰地上，浑身剧痛，意识几度陷入模糊。寒风裹挟着冰雪落在身上，冻得他浑身僵硬，若不是凭着一股不肯就此死去的执念硬撑着，昨夜恐怕就已经冻毙在街头了。
拼尽最后一丝力气，他爬回了这间破败的茅草屋，蜷缩在青石板上，熬过了漫漫寒夜。
时至今日，伤痛依旧盘踞在身躯之中，可烬孤宸的心中，却没有升腾起滔天的恨意，也没有汹涌的不甘。
在这片低等凡俗世界里，弱肉强食，本就是亘古不变的规矩。
强者可以肆意妄为，弱者只能任人宰割。他孤苦无依，身无长物，孱弱如风中残烛，被人欺凌，仿佛是理所当然的事情。怨天尤人，改变不了现状；痛哭哀嚎，也换不来半分怜悯。这么多年的底层挣扎，早已磨平了他心中多余的情绪，只剩下最纯粹的清醒与冷漠。
他缓缓放下捂着胸口的手，目光落在自己的掌心。
那是一只布满薄茧、带着细小伤口的手，掌心纹路杂乱，虎口处还有一道尚未愈合的划痕。而在掌心中央，静静躺着一枚巴掌大小的黑色骨片。
骨片色泽暗沉，表面凹凸不平，看起来平平无奇，像是野兽死后遗留的残骨，丢在路边都不会有人多看一眼。这是母亲弥留之际，塞到他手中的唯一物件。从记事起，这枚骨片便一直陪在他身边，整整十年，从未离身。
旁人都说这只是一块无用的碎骨，可只有烬孤宸自己知道，这东西并不寻常。
每逢他身陷绝境，饿到濒死，或是被人打伤、身受重伤之时，这枚黑骨便会悄然散发出一缕难以察觉的温热。那暖意并非来自外界，而是从骨片内部渗透而出，顺着掌心经脉流淌至四肢百骸，抚平一部分伤痛，维系住他最后一缕生机。
十年间，无数次生死边缘，都是这枚神秘残骨，将他从鬼门关拉了回来。
以往，这缕温热都极为微弱，如同萤火之光，聊以续命而已。但就在方才，当他咳出血丝，身躯被伤痛与寒冷双重折磨之时，掌心的黑骨忽然剧烈地滚烫起来。
热度来得迅猛而霸道，绝非往日那般温和。
烬孤宸能清晰地感觉到，一股精纯、浩瀚、远超这片凡俗世界所能孕育的奇异能量，从骨片之中汹涌涌出，顺着掌心经络，疯狂冲入他的体内。
霎时间，剧痛席卷了全身每一寸血肉。
断裂的肋骨、受损的经脉、淤青肿胀的腿骨，仿佛被万千根细密的针芒同时穿刺，又像是有熊熊烈火在皮肉之间灼烧。肌肉抽搐，筋骨震颤，原本就孱弱的肉身，在这股力量的冲刷下，好似随时都会崩碎瓦解。
换做寻常人，遭遇这般撕筋裂骨的痛苦，定然会痛呼出声，挣扎扭曲，甚至直接昏厥过去。
但烬孤宸只是眼睑微微颤动了一下，周身依旧保持着盘膝而坐的姿势。

额角渗出细密的冷汗，顺着苍白的脸颊滑落，滴在冰冷的地面上，瞬间便凉透。牙关死死咬紧，口腔内壁被牙齿磨出了血味，可他自始至终，没有发出半点声响。十年底层求生，无数次生不如死的遭遇，早已让他练就了远超常人的忍耐力。
痛苦如同潮水，一波接着一波，连绵不绝。
那股奇异能量在他体内流转，沿着周身一条条细微的脉络穿行。原本淤塞、脆弱的经脉，被这股力量不断冲刷、拓宽、重塑。断裂的骨骼传来酥麻又刺痛的感觉，受损的骨茬一点点对接、愈合，甚至有一股生生不息的力量，在滋养着骨膜，让本就单薄的骨骼，悄然变得更加坚韧。
体表破烂衣衫下的肌肤，泛起一层淡淡的黑雾光泽，表层多年积攒的污垢、细微的旧伤，都在能量的涤荡下缓缓消融。皮下的血肉被反复淬炼，褪去虚浮，沉淀出紧实的质感。
他能清晰地感知到身体的变化。
content_en:
In the twelfth lunar month of winter, the north wind swept the snow, like countless cold knives, cutting every inch of land in Blackstone Town of Qingyuan Kingdom.
This small town located on the edge of the Canglan Region is an ordinary corner of this low-level mortal world. The spiritual energy between heaven and earth is so thin that it is almost nothingness. There are neither immortals who can fly to the sky and escape from the earth, nor gods and demons who can call the wind and rain. People in the world can't escape the cycle of birth, old age, illness and death. A hundred years of life can be gone in a blink of an eye. Here, the definition of a strong person has never been about comprehending the Tao and mastering the laws, but only being strong and healthy, able to earn a bite of food and protect one's own life in the troubled times and cold winters.
The westernmost side of the town is a continuous low-rise shantytown. The houses are all made of yellow mud mixed with broken thatch. The walls are mottled and cracked, and exposed dead branches can be seen in many places. The cold wind passed through the cracks in the wall, whistling like a lonely soul crying in the middle of the night. The entire street was full of potholes, and the road surface was covered with thick ice, mixed with frozen sludge and rotten vegetable leaves. It creaked when you stepped on it, and you would slip and fall to the ground if you weren't careful.
Deep in the streets, a crumbling thatched house is where Jin Guchen lives.
The house was less than two feet square, with drafts coming from all sides. The thatch on the roof had long since rotted, and fine snow foam fell down along the gaps, accumulating a thin layer on the cold mud floor. There were no tables, chairs, or beds in the house. There was only a smooth bluestone slab placed horizontally in the corner. It was the only place where the young man could rest. The air was filled with a thick chill, mixed with a faint smell of musty and dust, so cold that one's blood seemed to be about to solidify.
Jin Guchen sat cross-legged on the bluestone.
He was wearing a tattered coarse linen garment. The fabric had long lost its original color, was torn in many places, and the cotton wool was exposed. It could not withstand the biting cold wind. His figure is shockingly thin, with a slender neck and thin shoulders. Through the shabby clothes, you can clearly see the bulging joints under the skin. It is obvious that he has been underfed all year round and suffered from hunger and cold.
The young man was about fifteen or sixteen years old. His face was not handsome, but he had an extremely handsome appearance. His skin color was pale, having not seen the warmth of the sun for a long time. His jawline was tight, and his lips were bloodless and tightly pressed into a cold, straight line. The most eye-catching thing is his eyes, which are a pair of dark and deep eyes. They are not filled with ignorance, hope or resentment like those of teenagers of the same age. Instead, they are like a thousand-year-old cold pool, silent and indifferent, with no emotion ups and downs visible, as if nothing in the world can enter his eyes.
The long eyelashes drooped, covering up the sharpness deep in the eyes that no one noticed. His back was straight, and even though he was in such a dilapidated and cold place, even though his whole body was scarred, his posture was not even a little rickety. He was like a lonely pine standing alone in the wind and snow. Even though his foundation was shallow, he refused to bow to fate.
A violent cough suddenly came from his chest, dull and depressing.
His body trembled slightly, Jin Guchen raised his hands to cover his chest, his knuckles turned white from the exertion. Strands of fishy sweetness surged up his throat. He tilted his head, and a drop of dark red blood fell on the mud at his feet. It looked particularly dazzling against the pale snow foam.
The three broken ribs in his chest were still aching, and every breath involved the damaged meridians, causing waves of heartbreaking pain. My right leg didn't dare to move easily. It was kicked hard by a thick wooden stick yesterday. Although the bone was not completely broken, it was swollen and the skin and flesh were bruised. It was stiff and numb at the moment, and the pain was excruciating at the slightest exertion.
Memories are like cold water, slowly spreading in my mind.
Yesterday afternoon, the sky was overcast, and the wind and snow were a bit more violent than today. He had been hungry for two whole days, his stomach was empty, his internal organs seemed to be mixed together, and the feeling of hunger was gnawing at his will. In order to survive, he held on to his weak body and went to the streets in the center of the town to try his luck and see if he could pick up some scraps discarded by others.Chilled.
To the east of Blackstone Town is the area where wealthy households live together. The blue bricks and black tiles, and high-walled courtyards are like two worlds apart from the shanty towns to the west. The housekeeper of the Lin family, a wealthy local family, was traveling with several nurses. The accompanying servants accidentally dropped half a piece of coarse grain cake. The texture of the cake was rough and mixed with a lot of wheat bran. It was not worth mentioning in the eyes of wealthy people, but for Jin Guchen who was extremely hungry, it was life-saving food.
He didn't think much about it at the time and just instinctively bent down to pick it up.
But this scene, in the eyes of the superior nurse, turned into a theft without knowing the heights and heights of the matter.
"Where does this wild boy come from and dares to pick up things from the Lin Mansion?"
A hoarse scolding sounded, and several strong guards immediately surrounded him. These people have been doing rough work all year round and have strong bodies. They usually dominate the town and bully the weak. It has long been the norm. Before Jin Guchen could defend himself, fists and kicks fell like raindrops.
He was lonely since he was a child, without a father or a mother. When he was five years old, his parents passed away one after another, leaving him without any relatives in this huge world. Over the years, he had been surviving by begging and picking up sundries. He had never learned any self-defense skills. He was so thin that he had no strength to resist at all when faced with the beatings of several strong men.
Fists hit his chest, wooden sticks kicked his legs, and cold curses mixed with joking laughter echoed in the streets. They struck hard, with no regard for his life or death, as if beating such a helpless boy was just a fun way to kill boredom. Finally, the leading guard kicked him down on the icy road, sneered and spat, and led everyone away.
Half of the coarse grain cake was trampled to pieces and mixed into the muddy water, making it completely inedible.
And he was lying on the ice, with severe pain all over his body and his consciousness was blurred several times. The cold wind brought ice and snow to his body, making him stiff from the cold. If he hadn't been holding on with an obsession that refused to die, he would have frozen to death on the street last night.
Using his last bit of strength, he climbed back into the dilapidated thatched house, huddled on the bluestone floor, and survived the long cold night.
To this day, the pain is still lingering in his body, but in Jin Guchen's heart, there is no overwhelming hatred or raging unwillingness.
In this low-level mortal world, the law of the jungle is the eternal law.
The strong can do whatever they want, while the weak can only be slaughtered. He was helpless, had nothing to offer, and was as weak as a candle in the wind. Being bullied seemed to be a matter of course. Blaming others will not change the status quo; crying and wailing will not bring any sympathy. So many years of struggling at the bottom have long since worn away the excess emotions in his heart, leaving only the purest sobriety and indifference.
He slowly put down the hand covering his chest and looked at his palm.
It was a hand covered with thin calluses and with small wounds. The lines on the palm were messy, and there was an unhealed scratch at the tiger's mouth. And in the center of the palm, lying quietly was a black bone fragment the size of a palm.
The bone fragments are dark in color and have uneven surfaces. They look ordinary and unremarkable, like the bones left behind after the death of a beast. No one would take a second look if they were thrown on the roadside. This was the only thing his mother put into his hands when she was dying. For as long as he could remember, this bone fragment had been with him, and it had never left him for ten years.
Others said it was just a useless broken bone, but only Jin Guchen knew that this thing was unusual.
Whenever he was in a desperate situation, starving to the point of death, or being beaten or seriously injured, this black bone would quietly emit an imperceptible warmth. The warmth did not come from the outside world, but penetrated from the inside of the bone fragments, flowing along the meridians in the palms to the limbs and bones, healing some of the pain and maintaining his last glimmer of life.
In the past ten years, he has been on the verge of life and death countless times, and it was this mysterious bone that pulled him back from the gate of hell.
In the past, this ray of warmth was extremely weak, like the light of a firefly, just to survive. But just now, when he was coughing up blood and his body was tortured by pain and cold, the black bones in his palm suddenly became violently hot.
The heat came quickly and overbearingly, not as gentle as before.
Jin Guchen could clearly feel that a pure, vast, strange energy that far exceeded what this mortal world could produce surged out from the bone fragments, rushed into his body along the meridians in his palms.
In an instant, severe pain swept through every inch of flesh and blood in his body.
The broken ribs, damaged meridians, and bruised and swollen leg bones seemed to be pierced by thousands of fine needles at the same time, or like a raging fire burning between the skin and flesh. Muscles twitched, muscles and bones trembled, and the already weak body seemed to be shattered and disintegrated at any time under the wash of this force.
If it were an ordinary person, encountering such pain that tears apart muscles and bones, he would definitely scream in pain, struggle and twist, or even faint.
But Jin Guchen's eyelids only trembled slightly, and his whole body still maintained the posture of sitting cross-legged.
A thin layer of cold sweat broke out from his forehead, sliding down his pale cheeks and dripping onto the cold ground, instantly cooling him down. He clenched his teeth tightly, and the inner wall of his mouth tasted like blood from the grinding of his teeth, but he didn't make any sound from the beginning to the end. Ten years of survival at the bottom, and countless encounters where life was worse than death, had already allowed him to develop endurance far beyond that of ordinary people.
Pain is like a tide, one wave after another, endless.
That strange energy was flowing inside his body, traveling along the tiny veins all over his body. The meridians that were originally clogged and fragile were continuously washed, broadened, and reshaped by this force. There was a numbing and tingling feeling from the broken bones, and the damaged bone stubbles connected and healed little by little. There was even an endless force nourishing the periosteum, making the already thin bones quietly become stronger.
The skin under the tattered clothes on the body has a faint black mist sheen, and the dirt and minor old wounds accumulated over the years are slowly melting away under the cleansing energy. The flesh and blood under the skin has been repeatedly tempered, losing its fluffiness and settling into a firm texture.
He could clearly feel the changes in his body.
